extraction: Unified memory workflow validation: after each handoff, validator checks: (1) Required fields present (decision_id, agent, timestamp, payload). (2) Schema compliance (JSON schema per scope). (3) Provenance chain unbroken (task→session→project). (4) No stale data (session scope < 24h). Maps to our Engine→Verdict→Miss: Engine output validated before Verdict reads; Verdict fix spec validated before Miss reads; Miss patch validated before Verdict re-verifies. Prevents garbage propagation.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether unified-memory validation runs automatically on every scope promotion
